metadata.challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: Flame in Freefall
metadata.evidence_policy: Partial-gravity (0.16g Lunar, 0.38g Martian) results must always be labeled as theoretical bounds/interpolations because NASA PSI currently contains no direct partial-gravity combustion datasets.

example_response.summary_text: Under proposed Lunar habitat conditions (70.3 kPa, 30% O2), stoichiometric CH4 reaches an equilibrium adiabatic flame temperature of 2518.4 K (~292 K hotter than standard ISS air), moderated by endothermic CO2 and H2O dissociation.
